claude.rationale: The multi-family assets (T4) were brought across primarily by buying out JV partners and consolidating the properties, and the operating processes that run them (T5) sat with the already-acquired Roseland platform, with a Form of Shared Services Agreement between Mack-Cali Realty, L.P. and Roseland Residential, L.P. explicitly allocating shared services alongside the assets — so product and its processes moved/aligned together (gap_45=0). Likewise, the Roseland operating platform's founding principals (Tycher, Klatt, Goldberg) were parties to the 2012 platform-purchase agreement and remain named key personnel running the operations, so the people/organization (T6) transferred and stayed aligned with the processes (T5), yielding gap_56=0. The multi-family business is housed in a distinct RRT/RRLP vehicle (T3 swap into a separate domiciled sub-structure) bridged to the parent by the Shared Services Agreement, indicating coherent alignment of substrate at the closing-era structure.

gemini.rationale: The drawn accession is an earnings/operations furnishing (8-K Item 2.02) reporting quarterly leasing results, not a structural transaction crossing an ownership boundary. Therefore, no structural gaps (gap_45 or gap_56) were created at closing.

openai.rationale: The acquired multi-family properties were consolidated into a portfolio whose operations were conducted through the Company's Roseland subsidiary, while the Company performed substantially all leasing, management, acquisition, and development in-house [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-012551, 10-K FY2016]. Accordingly, the customer-facing rental assets were structurally paired with an identified operating platform rather than transferred without processes. Roseland's named key personnel and residential-development and leasing expertise remained within that operating structure, and a Shared Services Agreement allocated services between Mack-Cali Realty, L.P. and Roseland Residential, L.P.; therefore no process-versus-organization gap is documented at closing [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-17-012551, 10-K FY2016].
